description: This Java class defines the 'Allergy' entity within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It models an allergy record associated with a patient, including allergen details, severity, comments, reactions, and linked encounter. It provides methods for accessing and manipulating allergy data, comparing allergy instances, copying data, and managing related reactions.

classes.name: Allergy
classes.description: Represents an allergy record for a patient, including allergen information, severity, comments, reactions, and associated encounter. Provides methods to access, modify, compare, and copy allergy data.

methods.name: getAllergyId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the allergy record.

methods.name: setAllergyId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the allergy record.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the OpenmrsObject method to return the allergy's ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the OpenmrsObject method to set the allergy's ID.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Returns the patient associated with this allergy record.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Sets the patient associated with this allergy record.

methods.name: getAllergen
methods.description: Returns the allergen details.

methods.name: setAllergen
methods.description: Sets the allergen details.

methods.name: getAllergenType
methods.description: Returns the type of allergen.

methods.name: setAllergenType
methods.description: Sets the allergen type using AllergenType enum.

methods.name: setAllergenType
methods.description: Sets the allergen type based on a string value.

methods.name: getSeverity
methods.description: Returns the severity concept of the allergy.

methods.name: setSeverity
methods.description: Sets the severity concept.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns comments related to the allergy.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments related to the allergy.

methods.name: getReactions
methods.description: Returns the list of reactions associated with the allergy.

methods.name: setReactions
methods.description: Sets the list of reactions, ensuring it's non-null.

methods.name: addReaction
methods.description: Adds a new reaction to the allergy.

methods.name: removeReaction
methods.description: Removes a specified reaction.

methods.name: getDateLastUpdated
methods.description: Returns the date when the allergy was last updated.

methods.name: hasSameValues
methods.description: Compares this allergy with another to check if they have the same data.

methods.name: hasSameReactions
methods.description: Checks if reactions match between two allergy instances.

methods.name: getAllergyReaction
methods.description: Retrieves a reaction by its ID.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies all properties from another allergy instance, including reactions.

methods.name: getReactionConcepts
methods.description: Helper method to extract reaction concepts from reactions.

methods.name: getReactionNonCoded
methods.description: Returns a non-coded reaction string if present.

methods.name: getReaction
methods.description: Retrieves a reaction matching a specific concept.

methods.name: hasSameAllergen
methods.description: Checks if this allergy shares the same allergen as another.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Returns the associated encounter.

methods.name: setEncounter
methods.description: Sets the associated encounter.
